name: The token was refused but the cookie is good: the iframe picks the renewal up and the user sees nothing
description: The token endpoint is unreachable for one renewal, so the request with the refresh token fails and the token is dropped - it might have been spent, and nobody can tell. With the endpoint reachable again there is nothing left to refresh with, and oidc-client-ts asks with the SSO cookie through its hidden iframe instead. That is the way that exists for a provider on the same site as the application: the session carries on and no popup is shown.
